card.name: Two Sidon sets with disjoint difference sets

task.name: Two Sidon sets with disjoint difference sets
task.description: construct() -> [A,B], two nonempty Sidon subsets of [1,n=256], at most 64 elements each. Pair sums inside each set, including a+a, must be unique. Their nonzero difference sets must be disjoint. Maximize |A|+|B|; A and B need not themselves be disjoint. Two Sidon subsets of [1,256]; maximize combined size and require disjoint nonzero differences. Ordinary Sidon diagonals are included, and the two sets themselves may overlap.
